accessoryType.title: Accessory Type
accessoryType.description: Choose which HomeKit accessory type to use for this instance. Create multiple configs with different types to have multiple accessories.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: Your Spotify Developer Application Client ID.

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Your Spotify Developer Application Client Secret.

authCode.title: Authorization Code
authCode.description: Paste the 'code' parameter from the Spotify callback URL for initial token setup.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Optional: Existing Refresh Token if already generated.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to check Spotify playback state (in seconds).

homebridgeUrl.title: Homebridge URL (for Trigger)
homebridgeUrl.description: URL to your Homebridge instance (optional, for wake-up trigger).

homebridgeUsername.title: Homebridge Username (for Trigger)
homebridgeUsername.description: Optional: Username for Homebridge auth (needed for wake-up trigger).

homebridgePassword.title: Homebridge Password (for Trigger)
homebridgePassword.description: Optional: Password for Homebridge auth (needed for wake-up trigger).

triggerSwitchUuid.title: Trigger Switch UUID (for Trigger)
triggerSwitchUuid.description: Optional: UUID of a switch accessory to trigger for wake-up.

maxVolume.title: Max Volume (for Fan)
maxVolume.description: Maximum volume limit when using Fan accessory (optional).
